convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load BykovTrend custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for position open/close, money management, and global variable handling. Custom indicator cannot be auto-converted without reimplementing its logic.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade signal timing

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position when BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are enabled; historical bar scan checks for close signals on bars beyond SignalBar when both open and close on same side are enabled

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lots, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus losses, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus losses. MM input (0.1) is the fraction or lot size depending on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: BykovTrend is a custom indicator loaded via iCustom with 2 buffers: Buffer 0 = down/sell signal dots, Buffer 1 = up/buy signal dots. Non-zero non-EMPTY_VALUE on a bar indicates a signal. When SignalBar=0, the EA processes signals intrabar (every tick). When SignalBar>0, only on new bars. The EA has a historical close-signal scan: if both BuyPosOpen+BuyPosClose or SellPosOpen+SellPosClose are enabled and no close signal was found on SignalBar, it scans forward bars to find a close signal. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean gates allowing selective enable/disable of each direction's entry and exit. UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime are derived from SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec for trade management timing.
python_conversion_notes: BykovTrend custom indicator must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented in Python. The indicator uses RISK and SSP parameters (RISK likely controls signal sensitivity, SSP likely is WPR period). TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, and CIsNewBar - all must be reimplemented. The MarginMode enum has 5 modes for position sizing that must be faithfully ported. The historical close-signal scan loop (lines 131-157) is non-trivial: when both open and close permissions exist for a side and no close signal is on SignalBar, it scans historical bars forward to find the first close signal, which affects trade timing. SignalBar=0 vs SignalBar>0 changes behavior from intrabar to new-bar-only mode.
